audit.whatIsWrong: The entry never names a single Renekton ability and describes his stun only as 'W stun' / 'fury combo'. It also never states what Fury actually changes about Ruthless Predator.
audit.why: Riot's own text: Ruthless Predator at 50+ Fury slashes three times instead of twice, stuns for 1.5s instead of 0.75s, and destroys damage shields on the target. That is the whole reason his rage bar decides when Mel may step forward — a half-empty bar is a 0.75s stun she can walk out of, a full bar is a 1.5s lockdown.
audit.corrected: Name the abilities (Reign of Anger, Cull the Meek, Ruthless Predator, Slice and Dice, Dominus) and state the 50-Fury threshold: 0.75s stun becomes 1.5s plus shield destruction.

audit.whatIsWrong: The text says 'punish the long cooldowns' without ever giving a number, so the reader has nothing to count.
audit.why: Ruthless Predator is 16/14/12/10/8s and Slice and Dice is 16/14.5/13/11.5/10s, while Solar Snare is 11/10.5/10/9.5/9s. At rank 1 Mel's root comes back five seconds before either of his answers — that gap is the entire lane.
audit.corrected: State the real numbers: his stun and his dash are both 16s at rank 1, your snare is 11s.

audit.whatIsWrong: Cull the Meek's heal is never mentioned, so no anti-heal timing is given.
audit.why: Cull the Meek is a 7s cooldown that heals him for part of the damage dealt, increased above 50 Fury. In an extended wave fight he heals back the chip Mel's Overwhelm plan depends on, which makes Grievous Wounds a real itemisation decision rather than a default.
audit.corrected: Flag Cull the Meek's 7s heal and Morellonomicon as the answer when he tries to grit through poke.

audit.why: Content and win rate agree: Mel owns levels 2 through first item and Renekton owns the 2+ item flank, matching a 54.55% Mel win rate over 11 games.

edits.before: Q poke plus Solar Snare root lands a free punish the moment he dashes in for a cannon or steps up to last-hit.
edits.after: Radiant Volley plus an 11s Solar Snare punishes free the moment Slice and Dice commits him to a cannon or a last-hit.

edits.before: Renekton's biggest window: empowered W stun into a fury Q combo can chunk you before your kit is fully online — never get caught at melee range early.
edits.after: Renekton's biggest window: at 50+ Fury, Ruthless Predator stuns 1.5s instead of 0.75s and Cull the Meek chunks you — stay out of melee range early.

edits.before: Save Solar Snare's root to punish his W-stun dash the instant he commits, then kite out
edits.after: Snare the instant Slice and Dice lands — his dash is 16s at rank 1, your root 11s

edits.before: Land his W stun and a fury-empowered Q-E combo on you while you have no E up
edits.after: Land Ruthless Predator above 50 Fury for a 1.5s stun while your E is down

edits.before: With Q, E and W up you poke, root his engage and Rebuttal can eat his dash-trade, denying his fury all-in.
edits.after: With Q, E and W up you poke, snare the spot Slice and Dice lands on, and Rebuttal blanks the Cull the Meek chunk.

edits.before: Your Q ranks up and Overwhelm stacks pile from every trade — he can't sustain your chip and his fury windows go on cooldown.
edits.after: Your Q ranks up and Overwhelm piles on, but Cull the Meek heals him back every 7s — Morellonomicon is what ends that argument.

edits.before: - Renekton Ruthless Predator (Stun): matchup-defining — Fury-empowered stun — never trade into a full rage bar. It governs your forward steps. - W Rebuttal spent on poke is a death you scheduled. - Hold the R for the fight that decides something.
edits.after: - Renekton Ruthless Predator (Stun): 16s at rank 1, and above 50 Fury it stuns 1.5s and destroys shields. Slice and Dice is 16s too; your snare is 11s. - W Rebuttal spent on poke is a death you scheduled. - Hold the R for the fight that decides.

edits.before: Stack Overwhelm with every hit — once he's marked deep, your execute math starts working. Track Ruthless Predator (Stun) before stepping up.
edits.after: Stack Overwhelm with every hit — your 11s Solar Snare cycles faster than a rank-1 Ruthless Predator's 16s, so trade right after the stun.

edits.before: Track Renekton’s Ruthless Predator (Stun): Fury-empowered stun — never trade into a full rage bar. Forward steps wait for its downtime.
edits.after: Track Renekton’s Ruthless Predator (Stun): above 50 Fury it slashes three times, stuns 1.5s and eats damage shields outright.

edits.before: Fury-empowered stun — never trade into a full rage bar. Commit on its cooldown, never into it.
edits.after: Above 50 Fury it stuns 1.5s and destroys shields — commit once that rage bar is spent.

notes: The packet's suspectName 'Solar Snare's' is a false positive — that is Mel's real E name with a possessive. The full layer's phases[].side is 'Renekton' for all seven stages while the content layer's win[] gives Mel five of seven and the win rate is 54.55%; phases[].side cannot be proposed as an edit because the applier requires a full-layer 'before' of at least 12 characters and 'Renekton' is 8, so this contradiction needs a manual pass.
